query:
SELECT
            qs.song_id,
            qs.queued_at,
            COALESCE(tl.likes_count, 0::smallint) AS "likes!: i16",
            COALESCE(ul.user_likes_count, 0::smallint) AS "user_likes!: i16"
        FROM
            queued_song qs
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT
                l.queue_id,
                l.song_id,
                SUM(l.count)::smallint AS likes_count
            FROM
                likes l
            WHERE
                l.queue_id = qs.queue_id AND l.song_id = qs.song_id
            GROUP BY
                l.queue_id,
                l.song_id
        ) tl ON TRUE
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT
                l.queue_id,
                l.song_id,
                SUM(l.count)::smallint AS user_likes_count
            FROM
                likes l
            WHERE
                l.queue_id = qs.queue_id
                AND l.song_id = qs.song_id
                AND l.user_id = $2
            GROUP BY
                l.queue_id,
                l.song_id
        ) ul ON TRUE
        WHERE
            qs.queue_id = $1
